description: This file defines structures, functions, and utilities for quantized neural network operations using QNNPACK in PyTorch, including weight packing, operator management, and quantization helpers.

classes.name: PackedLinearWeightsQnnp
classes.description: Struct for packed linear weights in QNNPACK, storing original weights, bias, and quantization parameters.

classes.name: PackedConvWeightsQnnp
classes.description: Struct for packed convolution weights in QNNPACK, including operator setup and quantization info.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the quantized linear or convolution operation to input tensor.

methods.name: apply_relu
methods.description: Applies the quantized operation with ReLU activation.

methods.name: apply_dynamic
methods.description: Applies dynamic quantized operation, possibly with range reduction.

methods.name: apply_dynamic_relu
methods.description: Applies dynamic quantized operation with ReLU.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks the packed weights to retrieve original weight and bias tensors.

methods.name: prepack
methods.description: Prepares and packs weights for quantized operations.

methods.name: stride
methods.description: Returns the stride parameters for convolution.

methods.name: padding
methods.description: Returns the padding parameters for convolution.

methods.name: output_padding
methods.description: Returns the output padding parameters for convolution.

methods.name: dilation
methods.description: Returns the dilation parameters for convolution.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Returns the number of groups for convolution.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Returns whether the convolution is transposed.

methods.name: per_channel
methods.description: Returns whether the weights are per-channel quantized.
